categories.label: No known red flags
categories.summary: No strong phishing or coercion patterns matched our current rules. This is advisory only and never proves a message is safe.

categories.label: Some warning signs
categories.summary: Some warning signs were found. Verify independently using official apps, printed card helplines, or trusted contacts before taking action.

categories.label: Strong scam signs
categories.summary: Multiple high-risk scam or coercion indicators matched together. Do not pay, share OTPs/credentials, or stay on a pressure call.

rules.title: Authority or Official Impersonation
patterns: \b(?:cbi|central bureau of investigation|enforcement directorate|narcotics control bureau|ncb|cyber\s*crime\s*(?:cell|police|dept|department)|crime branch|income tax (?:officer|dept|department)|customs (?:officer|department|authority))\b
\b(?:trai|telecom regulatory|department of telecommunications|dot|rbi officer|reserve bank officer|supreme court|high court|magistrate)\b
\b(?:kyc (?:dept|department|desk|team|verification)|customer care executive|bank verification officer|parcel clearance officer)\b
\b(?:calling from|speaking from|official notice from|department notice|police headquarters)\b
rules.why_it_matters: Scammers frequently claim to be police, CBI, customs, TRAI, RBI, or bank verification officers to gain instant obedience and credibility.

rules.title: Arrest or Detention Threat
rules.why_it_matters: Indian law enforcement does not conduct 'digital arrests' or issue arrest threats via WhatsApp, SMS, or informal calls.

rules.title: Legal & Criminal Intimidation
rules.why_it_matters: Fabricated accusations of money laundering, illegal parcels, or misused Aadhaar/SIM cards are designed to trigger panic so victims stop verifying.

rules.title: Secrecy & Isolation Instruction
rules.why_it_matters: Scammers demand secrecy so family members, friends, or bank staff cannot warn you that the story is fake.

rules.title: Video-Call Surveillance Pressure
rules.why_it_matters: Forcing victims to stay continuously on video calls isolates them mentally and prevents them from contacting real authorities.

rules.title: Fake 'Safe-Account' Transfer Claim
rules.why_it_matters: No government agency, court, or RBI account ever holds personal savings for 'verification' or 'clearance'. Money sent to these accounts is stolen.

rules.title: Urgent Payment or Fee Demand
rules.why_it_matters: Pressuring for immediate transfers, penalties, or scanning QR codes/entering UPI PINs to 'receive' money is a classic fraud indicator.

rules.title: Request to Share OTP, PIN, or Password
rules.why_it_matters: Legitimate banks, police, and delivery partners never ask you to tell, forward, or enter your OTP or UPI PIN on unknown links.

rules.title: Request for Sensitive IDs or Remote Access
rules.why_it_matters: Sending Aadhaar/PAN/card images or installing remote-access apps allows attackers to take over banking sessions and steal identity documents.

rules.title: High-Pressure Urgency & Account Threat
rules.why_it_matters: Artificial deadlines and threats of sudden account or SIM suspension push people to act before checking official channels.

rules.title: Standalone Urgency Phrasing
rules.why_it_matters: Urgency words appear in both legitimate alerts and scams; on their own they carry low weight unless paired with threats, links, or demands.

rules.title: Isolated OTP Mention (Low Weight)
rules.why_it_matters: Mentioning 'OTP' alone is common in routine logins and deliveries and does not indicate a scam without a request to share it or click an untrusted link.

rules.title: Action Link or Unverified Contact Prompt
rules.why_it_matters: Scammers embed look-alike URLs, shortened links, or personal mobile numbers in official-sounding texts to divert victims away from real helplines.

combinations.title: Digital-Arrest Coercion Pattern
combinations.why_it_matters: Combining authority claims, arrest/legal fear, secrecy, video-call pressure, or safe-account demands strongly matches documented digital-arrest scam scripts.

combinations.title: Urgent Credential or Payment Phishing Pattern
combinations.why_it_matters: Combining urgency with a link/impersonation and a demand for OTPs, sensitive IDs, or payment is a classic phishing pattern.

combinations.title: Coercive Legal/Account Claim via Messaging Channel
combinations.why_it_matters: Genuine courts, police, and regulators do not serve arrest orders or demand verification transfers over SMS or WhatsApp.

benign_contexts.title: Protective Anti-Sharing OTP Notice
benign_contexts.explanation: Contains standard security wording advising you not to share your OTP.

benign_contexts.title: Routine Bank / UPI Transaction Notification
benign_contexts.explanation: Matches routine transactional receipt language without credential or payment coercion.

benign_contexts.title: Routine Delivery Status Notification
benign_contexts.explanation: Matches ordinary parcel status wording without payment demands or intimidation.
